title: Discord alerts
description: The site posts in a Discord server channel when something happens in the community's tournaments.

broken.title: Discord no longer recognizes this webhook
broken.body: It was deleted or its address changed, and no alerts are going out. Paste another webhook's address.

url.label: Webhook address
url.hint: Anyone with this address can post in the channel. Don't share it.
url.tip: In Discord, open Server Settings, Integrations, Webhooks, create a webhook for the channel, and paste its address here.
url.invalid: Use the address of a Discord webhook.

tournament.started: Tournament started, with the bracket link
tournament.tie_pending: Tie to decide, for the organizers

match.contest_received: Game disputed, for the opposing captain

stage.started: Stage started, with the bracket link

mention.label: Mention whoever linked Discord to the account with @
mention.hint: In match and organizer alerts. Anyone who hasn't linked Discord appears by nickname.

tested: Test message sent to the channel.
removeConfirm: Remove the webhook? Alerts stop going out, including the ones waiting in the queue. The webhook still exists in Discord.
